messages:
frank: Heads up support ticket — customer billed into a higher project band for a 20s spike. We need a proposal to avoid flip-flop routing causing bill noise.

nora: saw it. Console showed owner swapping twice in 40s which is messy.

kevin: quick thought: separate "serving" affinity (for latency) from "billing" affinity (for quota). By default serving can be aggressive but billing only changes after a sustain window.

frank: agreed. Also want readable events in logs so support can answer "who got billed when".

liz: telemetry: add fields `routing.serving_owner`, `billing.state` (pending|active|reverted), `billing.reason`. Index a small sample of full events.

kevin: behavior sketch: when burst triggers project for serving, set billing.state=pending and start a commit_timer. If sustained > commit_window -> commit billing to project; else revert and bill org.

nora: defaults? I propose commit_window=45s, serving_ttl=10s, demotion_cooldown=3600s, max_consecutive_commits=3/24h.

frank: safety: add shadow ledger for project usage during pending so we can reconcile if commit happens. Shadow entries must be exportable.

liz: UI: Key detail should show a compact timeline with markers: served->project, billing:pending->committed. Support wants search `billing.state:pending`.

kevin: API extras: POST /keys/:id/billing-override {target:"org"|"project:foo",ttl_sec,reason} returns prev policy. Admin only, audit-log required.

nora: what about DoS? Attackers could generate many short bursts to try to drift billing. Add a cap on commits per hour and exponential backoff in thresholds after reverts.

frank: also a per-key leaky bucket for shadow tokens with a decay rate to avoid accumulation from repeated short bursts.

kevin: telemetry wise include `billing.shadow_bytes` and `billing.pending_started_at` so analytics can compute average pending durations.

liz: rollout: feature-flagged canary at 2% keys x72h -> 10% x7d -> 100%. Metrics: pending_count, commits_total, reverts_total, avg_pending_duration, per_key_commit_attempts.

ops-bot: feature-flag `billing_affinity_split` enabled in staging at 1725010020 :white_check_mark:

kevin: ran synthetic 2k rps 30s burst against canary key. Observed pending but no commit (expected). Found minor timer rounding bug; patching.

frank: add a console kill-switch to disable for all keys if billing diffs are bad.

nora: agreed. Also add a read-only canary panel so support can watch keys in the canary group.

kevin: I'll draft RFC with commit logic, shadow ledger format, and billing-export changes so accounting reconciles. Will include runbook for manual commit/rollback.

liz: please include sample log lines in RFC and a mapping of decision_reason values (sustained,manual,anomaly,override). Support asked for plain text reasons.

frank: opening ticket and will link RFC. Thanks team.

ops-bot: Created PLAT-8201: "Transient affinity smoothing RFC + shadow ledger" assigned to kevin (https://tracker/redwood/PLAT-8201)
